bench_setup = function() {
	set.seed(20261117)
	n = 200L
	w = rep(c(0, 1), each = n / 2L)
	x1 = stats::rnorm(n); x2 = stats::rbinom(n, 1L, 0.4); x3 = stats::runif(n)
	X = cbind(1, w, x1, x2, x3)
	y = 1 + 0.5 * w + 0.8 * x1 - 0.4 * x2 + 0.3 * x3 + stats::rnorm(n)
	list(X = X, y = y)
}
notes: Delete-one jackknife of the OLS treatment coefficient at n=200, k=5 (all 200 replicates per call). The current side times only the fast_ols_cpp refit on X[-i,] per replicate and omits the R6 bootstrap_subset_inference/compute_estimate overhead, so it understates today's cost and is conservative for the candidate. Both are exact least squares; on this well-conditioned X the downdate should agree to ~1e-12.
